<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: Namels Matebeto -->

# DESIGN.md — Namels Matebeto

archetype: warm-trattoria
rationale: Namels Matebeto is a neighbourhood kitchen in Nakonde selling one plate, Nshima at K150, on the promise of "Tradional Fresh Food, Friendly faces." That is a familiar, unpretentious, everyday room, so it gets warmth and not fine-dining restraint. The owner's "fancy" is answered by a characterful warm serif set with care against full-strength #FF4E00 bands, not by luxury whitespace a K150 plate would not wear.
interaction_level: L1

personality: [warm, proud, generous, lively]

typography:
  display: "Fraunces"
  body: "Source Sans 3"
  scale: 1.333
  notes: Fraunces at a high optical size and soft weight carries every heading and every price. The fanciness lives here, so the display stays large and confident. The hero name is about 5.5rem on desktop and 2.75rem on mobile. Section headings are about 2.75rem and 1.875rem, then straight to body with no mid-size headings. Eyebrows are Source Sans 3 small caps at 0.8rem with 0.14em tracking. Body is 1.125rem at line-height 1.6 on a 62ch measure, comfortable and never thin. Fraunces italic is used only for the tagline and the pulled quote. K150 is always set in Fraunces figures.

palette:
  primary: "#FF4E00"
  secondary: "#FFF5F0"
  accent: "#FF9A62"
  ground: "#FFF5F0"
  surface: "#FFE9DE"
  ink: "#2B1206"
  muted: "#6E4A3A"
  border: "#EBCFC0"
  application:
    - The page ground is the brand's own secondary, #FFF5F0.
    - Primary #FF4E00 carries the full-bleed menu band and the hero's colour block. These bands give the page its rhythm.
    - Body and heading text on primary is ink #2B1206, at about 5.4:1.
    - Ground-coloured text on primary is used only at display size, at about 3.1:1, which passes for large text only.
    - The ink band (#2B1206) carries the hours. Accent #FF9A62 appears there as day names and hairlines, at about 8.5:1.
    - Accent is never used as text on the ground or surface. On light areas it is limited to hairline rules and the hover fill of the single action.
    - Muted #6E4A3A clears 7:1 on the ground and 6.7:1 on the surface.
    - Every neutral is pulled from a charred, ember-brown version of the primary. The page reads as an orange kitchen fire, not as stock greys under an orange logo.

composition:
  whitespace: balanced
  photography: none
  card_usage: none
  mobile:
    - Hero type drops to 2.75rem and stays left-aligned. The orange block moves beneath the name rather than beside it.
    - The menu's dish list collapses from two columns to one.
    - Every orange and ink band stays full-bleed with 1.5rem side padding.
    - The hours table keeps day and time on one line per row.
    - The contact form goes single-column with 48px tap targets.
    - No sticky bar.

composition: >
  The plate is the whole argument. People choose Namels Matebeto for nshima done
  traditionally, at a price they know, every day of the week. So the page leads
  with Nshima and K150 and the long run of fish, beef, goat, vimbombo, offals and
  kapenta named on the menu. After that, the only remaining question is "are they
  open?", and it gets a direct answer. The owner's boast is the page's voice, kept
  to their own two lines. Everything else is held back because nothing else exists.
  An honest short page that is simple to use is exactly what the owner asked for.

sections:
  - id: hero
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: Announce a warm, proud local kitchen and its one plate at once. With no photograph, the name and the price are the event.
    spec:
      - "Namels Matebeto" is set in Fraunces across most of the width, left-aligned on the #FFF5F0 ground.
      - Beneath it, the tagline "Tradional Fresh Food, Friendly faces." sits in Fraunces italic, verbatim including its spelling.
      - Beneath that is one small-caps line, "Open every day · 08:00–20:30".
      - A #FF4E00 block runs off the right edge on desktop and the bottom edge on mobile. The headline overlaps the block's edge in one deliberate collision.
      - The block holds "Nshima" and "K150" in ink Fraunces figures.
      - One text link leads to the menu and one to contact. No buttons cluster here.

  - id: offerings
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: Make one priced plate and its long list of dishes feel like a full, generous table rather than a thin menu. This is the moment the owner points at.
    spec:
      - The section is a full-bleed #FF4E00 band, headed by an eyebrow "Menu" in ink small caps.
      - "Nshima" is set very large in Fraunces in ink, with "K150" on the same baseline joined by a hairline leader.
      - Beneath it, the menu's group heading is set as a typeset list exactly as named: Fried Fish, Boiled Fish, Smoked Fish, Dry Fish, T-bone, Beef stew, Beef Sausage, Goat Meat, Vimbombo, Offals, Kapenta. The list runs in two columns on desktop and one on mobile, in Source Sans 3 in ink, with ink-at-20% hairlines between rows.
      - No prices sit beside these names.
      - No new label such as "relishes" or "sides" is added.
      - No copy claims what K150 includes.
      - No icons, cards or images.

  - id: story
    priority: supporting
    show: all
    intent: Let the owner's own confident boast be the voice of the place, rooted in Nakonde.
    spec:
      - An eyebrow above the quote may carry "The Best Food You can Eat." verbatim, in small caps.
      - The first story line is a pulled quote in Fraunces italic at about 2.5rem on a narrow measure, indented asymmetrically from the left: "After tasting our meals, you’ll wonder why you can’t/won’t stop coming."
      - The second line, "Welcome to the best Restaurant in nakonde.", follows in body type in muted.
      - The section sits on the ground with a single #FF9A62 hairline, and nothing more.

  - id: hours_location
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: Answer "are they open?" instantly. It gives hours only, because there is no address to give.
    spec:
      - The section is a full-bleed ink (#2B1206) band.
      - "Open every day" is set large in Fraunces, in ground colour.
      - Beneath it, all seven days sit in an aligned table: the day on the left in accent, "08:00-20:30" on the right in ground colour.
      - Rows are separated by #FF9A62 hairlines.
      - No map, no address line, and no "find us" heading.

  - id: contact
    priority: supporting
    show: all
    intent: Give visitors the one way to reach the kitchen, since no phone, email or address exists.
    spec:
      - The section is a band on the surface tint (#FFE9DE) with a one-line Fraunces heading.
      - The form sits beside the heading on desktop and stacks below it on mobile. It has name, email and message fields.
      - Inputs have an explicit #FFF5F0 background and #2B1206 text, with placeholders in muted.
      - It posts to the Kora public forms endpoint with form_type "contact" and lazy-loaded reCAPTCHA v2.
      - The submit button is the page's only filled action, with ink text on #FF4E00. It is not labelled "Order online".

avoid:
  - An "Order online" button or nav item. The label exists in the data but there is no ordering destination, so it would be a dead promise.
  - Any phone, email, address, map pin or "Find us" heading.
  - Invented dishes, prices for the listed fish and meats, or copy claiming they come with the K150 Nshima.
  - Stock "happy diners" or food photography, illustrated plates, African-pattern clip-art borders, or a placeholder image box where a photo "would go".
  - Luxury-minimal whitespace or a hushed fine-dining tone that would make a K150 neighbourhood plate feel out of reach.
  - Cold greys or a thin geometric sans anywhere.
  - Correcting "Tradional" or "nakonde". The canonical text is reproduced as written.
  - Using #FF9A62 as text on the cream ground or the surface.
  - A centred hero over three cards, including any "Fresh · Local · Friendly" icon row built from the tagline.
  - Reviews, testimonials, star ratings, a gallery or a newsletter signup.
  - Extra pages, or nav links to anything beyond Menu, Hours and Contact as on-page anchors.
